jobs.description:
Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?

Then this might be your new challenge!



You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.



As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.



- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.

- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.

- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.

- You work with an electric pallet truck.

- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.

You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.

You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.

You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.

You enjoy active work.

You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:

Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:

No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:

Good knowledge of English

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a festive retail environment and helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holidays?

For a charming Christmas decoration store in the historic centre of Bruges, we are looking for a full-time Sales Associate who enjoys customer contact and creating a warm shopping experience.

What will you do:

• Welcoming customers and assisting them with their purchases

• Advising customers on Christmas Decorations, ornaments and gifts

• Keeping the store tidy and visually attractive

• Replenishing shelves and displays

• Operating the cash register and handling payments

• Helping with deliveries and unpacking new products

• You speak English and/or Dutch

• Flexible and willing to work weekends

• Previous experience in retail or sales is a plus

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

jobs.occupation: CE Dump Truck Driver – Reliable Shuttle Between Sint-Katelijne-Waver & Hemiksem
jobs.description:
As a CE Dump Truck Driver (m/f/x), you are responsible for daily shuttle transport between Sint-Katelijne-Waver and Hemiksem. You operate a tipper truck to ensure goods are loaded, transported, and unloaded safely and correctly. Safety, punctuality, and a strong sense of responsibility are key in this role.

Your average workday begins with a vehicle inspection. You load materials, depart on time to the next location, and ensure smooth delivery. In addition to transporting goods, you handle transport documents correctly and comply with driving and rest time regulations. You keep your truck clean and well-maintained. After your shift, you may take the truck home.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
